Ani Amiraghyan ( Armenian : Անի Ամիրաղյան ; born 9 October 1993) is an Armenian tennis player. Over her career, Amiraghyan won one singles title and seven doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . On 12 August 2013, she reached her best singles ranking of world No. 422. On 27 June 2016, she peaked at No. 505 in the doubles rankings. Playing for Armenia Fed Cup team , Amiraghyan has a overall win–loss record of 32–22, as of July 2024 (singles 21–10, doubles 11–12).
